newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil court suspends Bahia Band B tender - report.
newsitem.headline: Brazil court suspends Bahia Band B tender - report.

text.p: A regional Brazilian court has suspended the tender for a cellular Band B concession in the northeastern state of Bahia, local Invest News agency reported.

Citing a Ministry of Communications spokesman in Brasilia, who could not be reached for comment, Invest News said the Bahian Regional Federal Tribunal granted a request for an injunction presented by the Telecommunications Workers Union.
An official at the court could not immediately confirm the report.
Invest News said the Ministry of Communications would appeal the ruling, which could affect the timetable of Brazil's B and B privatizations.
Bids are due April 7 for 10 Band B service areas, Bahia being one.
